unsupported: Sentra-Sota Sheet Metal, Inc. was founded on May 26, 1982, by Ben Bechtold and Jerry Vogt in Waite Park, Minnesota.
As of 1999 the shop employed 27 people; current headcount is not publicly disclosed.
Its longevity and second-generation ownership under Jeff Bechtold, Jeff Popp, and Tyler Bechtold underscore a focus on continuity and customer relationships.
